title: Bitwise OR of Adjacent Elements
description: Given an array `nums` of length `n`, return an array `answer` of length `n - 1` such that `answer[i] = nums[i] | nums[i + 1]` where `|` is the bitwise `OR` operation.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Bitwise OR of Adjacent Elements.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
